excerpt.zh: 水循环系统需要进行一次高强度的紫外线杀菌，此过程只有在近恒星轨道上才能高效完成。疗愈中心与游泳池现已关闭，各层甲板均实行限量供水。
excerpt.en: The water recyclers need an intensive UV sterilization run that is only efficient in close stellar orbit. The spa and pool are closed and water is rationed across all decks.
